notes.title: Ultimate Monkey Race – Upcoming Graphics Update & New Maps!
notes.notes:
Big news, racers! 🐒🏁 A major update is on the horizon, bringing fresh visuals and brand-new maps.
 

✨ Visual Overhaul (Coming Soon)

A brand-new toon shader will give the game a bold, colorful style.

Updated models and assets make the entire world feel more cohesive and consistent, with everything fitting together better than ever.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899567/8d291f6c34666e37e8abe69d49bf93318b49e363.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899567/a18759ec1487f4a8c5c35fc8b34f9ae3afa86581.jpg"]

🗺️ 2 New Maps

Cosmic Chaos – Speed through outer space, dodge flying asteroids, and don’t get pulled into the black hole!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899567/c4780470a59a4188bff45fdc64b1f338769a50fc.png"]

Brick World – A playful vertical world built from colorful blocks. Climb higher and higher as you race your way to the top.  


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899567/cfbbcdb59438e73935e619f80ba5650fb468b74f.jpg"]

The update is just around the corner – get ready to test your skills on the new tracks and enjoy the refreshed look of Ultimate Monkey Race! 🚀

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Unfortunately I needed to revert version 1.0.3 for some days, because there was a bug with the camera, which is now fixed with 1.0.4.

Here are the changes for 1.0.4:


 Fixed: player camera sometimes switches to spectator if another player dies
 Improved: Add lag compensation for swinging axe
 Throwing a stone now applies a small impulse
 Increased fish impulse strength and added sound for a hit
 Improved the hitbox of the cannon when climbing

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Thanks for all your feedback and bug reports, I'm working on fixing them all.

Here are the changes for 1.0.3:


 Spiked balls now explode, killing the player who touches them and knocking away all nearby enemies
 Slightly increased probability of a bomb in the late game
 Fix: Spectator camera behaves strangely
 Fix: Player colors sometimes not correct when spawning
 Fix: Lobby player list cannot contain more than 8 players
